<ul>
<li><strong>Useful Applications:</strong> MiniPay focuses on practical uses in everyday life, especially in emerging markets, where most of their users are located.</li>
<li><strong>Integrated App Discovery:</strong> MiniPay includes a built-in app discovery page, allowing users to interact with selected Mini Apps directly within their wallet, without needing to switch to other platforms.</li>
<li><strong>Access to Opera’s Large User Base</strong> Developers can tap into MiniPay’s growing user base (10 Million activated addresses) and Opera browser distribution.</li>
</ul>

</ul>
